comments.content: The lambda in nursery.start_soon captures the loop variable 'merging_nodes' by reference. All tasks will see the final value of 'merging_nodes' after the loop completes. Fix by binding the current value: `nursery.start_soon(lambda mn=merging_nodes: self._merge_graph_nodes(graph, mn, change))`

The original code attempted to merge 'keywords' but the new code only merges 'source_id'. If 'keywords' should be merged, add: `node0_attrs["keywords"].extend(node1_attrs["keywords"]); node0_attrs["keywords"] = sorted(set(node0_attrs["keywords"]))`. If intentionally removed, add a comment explaining why.

The lambda in trio.to_thread.run_sync captures loop variables 'from_node' and 'to_node' by reference. All calls will use the final values after the loop. Fix by binding current values: `await trio.to_thread.run_sync(lambda fn=from_node, tn=to_node: settings.docStoreConn.delete({"knowledge_graph_kwd": ["relation"], "from_entity_kwd": fn, "to_entity_kwd": tn}, search.index_name(tenant_id), kb_id))`
